root: Uni-CLI 1.0.4 adds complete CCF A conference identity coverage with first-party AAAI and USENIX proceedings plus PACMPL, PACMSE, PACMMOD, and SIGGRAPH publication views.
Conference search validates the exact venue and year, follows ACM and IEEE publication changes, and removes companion material, administrative pages, and nearby acronym matches.
Cross-site traces connect OpenReview reviews and rebuttals, official awards, source-backed PDFs, code candidates, and datasets while retaining relationship evidence.
Academic requests now have bounded cancellation-aware deadlines, concurrent artifact collection, spelling recovery, structured source failures, and accurate file-writing effects.
zh: Uni-CLI 1.0.4 完整覆盖 CCF A 会议身份，并接入 AAAI 与 USENIX 官方论文来源，以及 PACMPL、PACMSE、PACMMOD 和 SIGGRAPH 出版视图。
会议检索会严格校验会议与年份，跟随 ACM 与 IEEE 出版变化，并剔除 companion 内容、管理页面和相近缩写误命中。
跨站追踪会连接 OpenReview 评审与作者回复、官方奖项、有来源依据的 PDF、代码候选和数据集，同时保留关系证据。
学术请求具备可取消的期限、并发资源收集、拼写恢复、结构化来源错误和准确的文件写入 effect。
